post.description: Any member of the coaching. Send the picture itself as the request body: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 10 MB and 40 megapixels. phase.title: Phase
phase.description: **Extensible: new values may be added, and a client must treat one it does not know as still in progress.** `RUNNING` (a Now run in progress); for an Economy run `QUEUED`, `SUBMITTING`, `SUBMITTED`, then an ending: `SUCCEEDED`, `FAILED`, `CANCELLED`, `EXPIRED`, or `SUBMISSION_UNKNOWN` (the provider never confirmed it; an admin must settle it).

cancel_requested.title: Cancel Requested
cancel_requested.description: The person asked to cancel; whatever still arrives is never applied.

apply_status.title: Apply Status
apply_status.description: What happened to the result: applied to the question, not applied (a test, a suggestion or a failure), out of date (the question changed meanwhile) or needing review (the person can no longer edit it).

answered_by.title: Answered By
answered_by.description: The model that answered, after any fallback.

result.title: Result
